★★★★★ Stepnoy Corner — A Taste of Home Near WKU
Reviewed by: Kamila S., 2nd year student
Visited: Friday evening, with two friends

I visited Stepnoy Corner for the first time three weeks ago, and I have been back four times since then. Located just five minutes on foot from the WKU main gate, this small café has quickly become my favourite place to eat in Uralsk. The atmosphere is warm and intimate — decorated with dried wildflowers, photographs of the Kazakh steppe, and soft traditional music. There are only eight tables inside, so it feels like a private dining room rather than a restaurant.

For my main course, I ordered the beshbarmak — Kazakhstan's national dish. It arrived in a large clay bowl with wide, flat noodles, tender lamb, fragrant onions, and a small pot of hot sorpa on the side. The meat was incredibly soft and flavourful — clearly slow-cooked for many hours. I had some concerns that a portion for 2,200 tenge might not be enough, but it was enormous — my friend and I shared it and were both completely full.

My friend Zhibek, who is vegetarian, ordered the pumpkin manty. She said it was the best she had ever eaten outside of her grandmother's kitchen. The dough was light and thin, the filling was sweet and creamy, and the sauce was perfectly balanced. There was a lot of flavour in every bite. To drink, I had a large pot of black tea with local wildflower honey. It was rich, aromatic, and incredibly comforting.

The service was attentive and friendly — the waiter checked on us twice during the meal, and the owner Gulnaz came out personally to ask if we enjoyed the food. The only small criticism I have is that the café gets quite busy between 12:30 and 14:00, so there is sometimes a short wait for a table. My advice: arrive before midday or after 14:30 to avoid the lunchtime rush.

In terms of value for money, Stepnoy Corner is excellent. Main dishes range from 1,500 to 2,500 tenge, and the daily set lunch — starter, main, and drink — is just 1,800 tenge. For the quality of the ingredients and the generosity of the portions, this is outstanding value. I would highly recommend Stepnoy Corner to any WKU student, especially those who miss home cooking. ★★★★★
